title: ScenePut
description: PUT /api/scenes/<name> (contract §4.4, §4.8): any of title, camera, camera_source, look. Camera values and look numbers are clamped (so any number is accepted); a look replaces only the keys it carries and a key set to null is removed. Unknown keys or wrong types are 400. saved is stamped unless only title changed.

title.description: Trimmed; at most 200 characters after that (400 otherwise); blank is null.

camera.title: CameraPatch
camera.description: Any of the camera block's keys, merged into the camera in use, then clamped (§4.1).

look.title: LookPatch
look.description: Numbers are clamped to the ranges of scene.schema.json's look; null removes a key.
